The ruling's three conditions are the acceptance: coverage of every derivation path measured and pinned BEFORE the split; the printed output of `--commands`, `--tier` and `--ran` byte-identical before and after over the fixture corpus plus this lane's three 2026-10-09 change sets, with the battery's seconds per tier before and after beside it; nothing else in the file under the lift. ⛔ No new gate family, no ratchet, no patrol line (ruling 208's 「⛔ 无原话不新增」 stands); ⛔ no edit to `.claude/**` (the freeze line in `instrument-discipline.md:10` stays as written). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (the MANDATORY line read: `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs package.json` ⇢ "no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 3 declared glob(s)"; reason: the seat's proactive upgrade — this instrument derives every card's gate families and the model tier itself, so a mis-split silently drops families or tiers for every later dispatch; a 30,049-line refactor with byte-identical pins is not the one-line mechanical class)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (a maintainer-ruled refactor: W3 of #22060 under #22453's letter A)
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: #22451 is in flight on the same file (branch `cfff9b1a` pushed, PR pending: exactly one pin at line 26400, `HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD` 5,000 → 3,000) — parallel authoring, SERIAL landing: this card's branch merges `origin/main` after #22451 lands and never rewrites that pin's meaning; #22452 (W1, queued) touches `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `platform-readings.md`, off this surface; no open PR touches `scripts/pm/**` (10 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-09T12:07Z; PR #22460 landed since); verify lock reads LOCKED (the #22451 battery) — the dev takes the lock protocol as `os-verify-lock.sh` prescribes; the lane holds no open p1.
